reason: The core mechanics hold. Our LB row is exp87a at 0.959 (e10_watch 20260929T0113Z l.272: count 53, last submission 12:14:57 with 3 night files pending, so the count and date track scored files only). A 0.958 display means an unrounded score below 0.9585, which is at or below exp87a's unrounded score, so it cannot move our row. For exp89p at 0.958, k = 0 by construction and '0u' cannot be reached. The only way to get k >= 1 at 0.958 is another completion inside the window (MASKED), and the logged codes (CONTEXT l.3937-3938) already map MASKED/BLIND to '0'. So A-M1 = exp89l iff exp89p is COMPLETE, has no ERROR and displays >= 0.959 (UNUSED if it is not terminal at the 08:40Z header). This matches the pre-registered text, and the line can be logged before any read (now 01:31Z, exp89p read ~07:38Z). Three caveats: (1) It adds no new information. scan_plancheck.json in the same round already reports that '0u' cannot be reached, and it changes no morning outcome. Its value is removing ambiguity and correcting the stale freeze (9) wording at l.4247 ('V_pub stays exp85a', written before probe 51). (2) The last sentence, 'k = 0 leaves exp87a first by the logged tie order', is not settled. R26-A4 (d), kept in force by freeze (5) l.4218, says '0/MASKED/BLIND are unresolved, never lower'. Under that rule a k = 0 exp89p at 0.959 falls through to tie step (2) non-CI, which picks exp89p. This is the open conflict PC30-01, and the logged line must not decide it implicitly. (3) exp89p as V_pub also needs L_hi <= 9.0 h (non-CI admission). The count 53 -> 54 check is valid only if exp89p completes first (expected ~07:46-07:58Z, before exp75 ~09:05Z+ and exp89r ~09:25Z+).
